metadata.title: Evaluating the Results of PISA Assessment: Are There Gaps Between the Teaching of Mathematical Literacy at Schools and in PISA Assessment?

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study does not use PISA-provided plausible values as outcomes or predictors, focusing instead on a locally administered test.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study used a purposive sample and did not apply sampling weights, treating the data as a convenience sample.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not mention using multilevel modeling or accounting for school clustering in its analysis.
design_fields.q4_rationale: There is no mention of any validation strategy beyond the internal analysis of the collected data.
